messages:
maria_support: heads up — multiple customers reporting per-model throughput lines disappeared from Console around 12:30 UTC. they see flat QPS for certain models and rising tail latency. examples attached by customers: acct-117 rwkv-3b, acct-202 ggml-13b. anyone seeing related alerts?

anya_sre: checking alerts now. I see an increase in errors on the dashboard route, but the grafana per-model panels are showing zeros for many models. quick prometheus check: `rate(redwood_model_requests_total[5m]) by (model_id)` returns zeros for several shards.

sam_platform: we pushed a metrics-exporter change in the 05:00 deploy that renamed label `model_id` -> `model` (and added `model_variant`). possible we broke existing dashboard queries that still use `model_id`.

mike_runtime: confirmed on the exporter side: new metrics expose `model` and `model_variant`. some older modelservers still emit `model_id` so panels are mixed — some lines present, others flat.

anya_sre: quick mitigation idea: add a relabel_config in prometheus scrape to copy `model` -> `model_id` so existing queries still work until we update dashboards. will that be safe?

sam_platform: yes, we can patch prometheus config as a compatibility shim. relabel snippet:
```yaml
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_model] # or the exporter label name
  target_label: model_id
  action: replace
```
I'll open a small infra PR and apply to prod.

lucy_support: escalated to P2 for impacted customers (acct-117, acct-202). sharing repro steps with them: 1) open Console -> Models -> select model -> switch to per-model throughput, 2) timeframe last 1h shows flatline. They've hit increased API latency while graphs are flat.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026 created: "console per-model qps missing" — priority P2. runbook: https://redwood.incidents/runbooks/metrics-missing

mike_runtime: note: some downstream systems rely on `model_id` in metrics for rollups/alerts. we should update alerts to accept either label to avoid dupes during migration.

anya_sre: rolling the relabel patch to staging now to validate. will watch grafana and prometheus targets.

sam_platform: PR merged to infra/metrics-config. kubectl apply -f prometheus-relabel-patch.yaml in prod. patch applied at 12:52 UTC. expected scrape relabel to take effect immediately; metrics should repopulate within scrape interval (~15s-1m).

maria_support: customers reporting graphs starting to repopulate, latency trending back to baseline. thanks for the quick turnaround. :pray:

mike_runtime: follow-up actions: 1) update Grafana queries to use `coalesce(label_replace(model, "model_id", "", "", ""), model)` or query both labels, 2) update alert rules to OR across labels, 3) add label-change checklist in release docs. I'll file tickets.

sam_platform: created INF-843: "metrics label migration - add backward-compat and release checklist". assigning to platform + runtime + docs.

anya_sre: marking incident resolved after 30m of stable metrics. will keep monitoring for 2 hours. closing note: be careful with label renames — they silently break dashboards and alerts. :white_check_mark:

maria_support: thanks all — please ping if anything else surfaces from customers.
